title: Programme Admission and Agreement Term Schedule — Legal Forwarding Agreements
content:
## Programmes, admission requirements and term

The Legal Forwarding Agreements are offered under six forwarding programmes, ranked from 1 to 6. This schedule states what a creditor client must show to enter each programme and the term periods that attach to the agreement: the calendar days after issue within which the client must sign, the minimum agreement term, the calendar days of notice for terminating the agreement, and the calendar days after termination during which matters already in suit continue.

### Admission requirements

| Rank | Programme | Active Contingency Placement Agreement | Cost deposit lodged | Minimum annual legal placements |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Attorney Demand Program | Required | — | — |
| 2 | Small Claims Suit Program | Required | Required | — |
| 3 | Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Required | Required | — |
| 4 | Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Required | — | at least 100 |
| 5 | Judgment Enforcement Program | Required | Required | — |
| 6 | Full-Service Litigation Program | Required | Required | at least 250 |

Every programme requires the client's Contingency Placement Agreement to be active. A lodged cost deposit is required for the Small Claims Suit, Client-Advanced Cost Suit, Judgment Enforcement and Full-Service Litigation programmes. A minimum of annual legal placements is required for the Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program (100) and the Full-Service Litigation Program (250); the Full-Service Litigation Program is the only programme requiring all three.

### Term periods

| Programme | Signature window after issue | Minimum agreement term | Notice for termination | Tail for matters already in suit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | 30 days | 6 months | 30 days | 0 days |
| Small Claims Suit Program | 30 days | 12 months | 30 days | 180 days |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 30 days | 12 months | 60 days | 365 days |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | 30 days | 12 months | 60 days | 365 days |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | 30 days | 12 months | 30 days | 365 days |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | 45 days | 24 months | 90 days | 365 days |

### Definitions

- *Signature window* — the calendar days after issue within which the client must sign; 45 days under the Full-Service Litigation Program and 30 days under every other programme.
- *Minimum agreement term* — the minimum term of the agreement, in months.
- *Notice for termination* — the calendar days of notice for terminating the agreement.
- *Tail* — the calendar days after termination during which matters already in suit continue. The Attorney Demand Program, which files no suits, shows 0 days.

### Admission readings (hypothetical clients)

| Hypothetical client position | Programmes whose admission requirements are met |
|---|---|
| Active Contingency Placement Agreement only; no cost deposit lodged; 80 legal placements a year | Attorney Demand Program |
| Active Contingency Placement Agreement; no cost deposit lodged; 120 legal placements a year | Attorney Demand Program, Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program |
| Active Contingency Placement Agreement; cost deposit lodged; 200 legal placements a year | every programme except the Full-Service Litigation Program |
| Active Contingency Placement Agreement; cost deposit lodged; 250 legal placements a year | all six programmes |
| Contingency Placement Agreement not active | none |
